build_CNN_encoder: build a CNN encoder module with ConvNet2D and MLP for VAE image encoding with flatten or avg_pool mode
build_MLP_module: build an MLP module that flattens input data and passes it through a multi-layer perceptron network
build_DeConv_decoder: build a DeConv decoder module with MLP and transposed convolution for VAE image reconstruction
build_BroadcastConv_decoder: build a BroadcastConv decoder that tiles latent vectors spatially and applies convolution with coordinate channels
build_LSTM_wrapper: build a multi-layer LSTM wrapper that processes batched sequence data with K parallel components
